name: Cross-asset attention contagion — BTC crowd spike leads the alts (4h)
rationale: MECHANISM: btc_social_accel (BTC social_volume log-change broadcast to every symbol) leads the mean-ALT return at k=1d. When BTC attention spikes, risk-on capital rotates into alts within a day (beta-plus-attention lead); the counterparty is alt holders who reprice a day late. The edge persists because it is a cross-sectional timing tilt majors can't scale into cheaply. Trade a basket long-alts pulse gated by a BTC accel spike; low turnover, exit as the BTC crowd fades. DISCONFIRMER: must beat simply being long-alt-beta when BTC pumps — regress out the CONTEMPORANEOUS BTC return; if the alt lead is pure lagged-beta with no attention-specific increment, KILL. Shuffle BTC's attention series independently of alt prices; the contagion must collapse under shuffle. Must clear 4h round-trip fees.
catalyst: a BTC social-attention spike broadcasting risk-on rotation into alts
